_what: What each codeline IS and what an agent working inside it needs to know that the source does not say. Produced by the codeline-discovery agent during THIS run and rewritten every run — never accumulated, so nothing here is older than the run that wrote it. The engine splits this per codeline into each worktree's .epam/.
_shape: Codeline names are TOP-LEVEL keys, because the engine extracts one with jq '.[$cl]'. Nesting them under another key parses fine and yields nothing for every codeline.

facts.text: The pretest script runs 'npm run build:config' which uses esbuild to compile next.config.source.ts into next.config.js; tests will fail if this step hasn't run because next/jest loads next.config.js.
The build throws an error and aborts if CLOUDINARY_DOMAIN or CLOUDINARY_CLOUDNAME environment variables are not set (except in test env).
facts.source: next.config.source.ts: if (!CLOUDINARY_DOMAIN || !CLOUDINARY_CLOUDNAME) { throw new Error("Missing required environment variables"); }

facts.text: Jest enforces a global coverage threshold of 60% for branches, functions, lines, and statements; 'npm run test:coverage-check' will fail if any metric drops below 60%.
facts.source: jest.config.js: coverageThreshold: { global: { branches: 60, functions: 60, lines: 60, statements: 60 } }
